item.case_name: Text on screen in a clip
item.group_name: Short video from a picture or text
item.title: Mountain Morning Opening Title

turns.text: Make a silent 6-second widescreen clip. Start with a dark green title card saying exactly “A quieter kind of morning” in cream lettering for 2 seconds, then cut to a slow moving shot of a misty mountain lake at sunrise. No other text.

item.tests: Checks exact, legible title-card text, its opening placement and duration, and the transition into moving scenery.

answer_sheet.Title wording: A quieter kind of morning — exactly this capitalization, without quotation marks.
answer_sheet.Title styling and timing: Cream lettering on a dark green title card for the first 2 seconds; font and layout are your call.
answer_sheet.Scene after the title: A slow moving shot of a misty mountain lake at sunrise.

must_haves: The opening title reads exactly 'A quieter kind of morning', with no quotation marks or extra text.
The title is legible cream lettering on a dark green card, fully inside the frame.
The title card occupies approximately the first 2 seconds, then cuts to the lake scene.
The remaining scene shows a misty mountain lake at sunrise with visible slow camera or scene motion.
The delivered video is silent, 16:9 and approximately 6 seconds long.

turns.text: Make a silent 6-second widescreen clip. Start with a dark green title card saying exactly “A quieter kind of morning” in cream lettering for 2 seconds, then cut to a slow moving shot of a misty mountain lake at sunrise. No other text. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
**I haven’t started any generation or spent any credits.** I can plan this, but the connected tools don’t expose your balance or an exact price quote, so I can’t reliably tell you the credit total before running it. I won’t submit a job to find out.

Your requested clip is:
- **0–2 seconds:** dark green title card with cream lettering: “A quieter kind of morning”
- **2–6 seconds:** hard cut to a gently moving misty mountain lake at sunrise
- **16:9 widescreen, silent, no other text**

For your free plan, the available video settings are **480p using LTX 2.5 or MiniMax H3**.

### Lower-cost options
| Approach | Trade-off |
|---|---|
| **Generate only the 4-second lake shot**, then add a static 2-second title card in a free video editor | Best way to preserve the exact text and timing while avoiding generating two seconds of a static card. Compare the generation quote first. |
| **Shorten the lake shot to 2 seconds** | Makes a 4-second finished clip; may reduce the generation cost. |
| **Use a still lake image with a slow zoom** | Avoids video generation and could be cheaper, but mist and water won’t actually move. |

**Smaller:** 480p is already the lowest supported resolution for those free-plan video models.

My recommendation is the **4-second lake generation plus a separately added title card**. AI-generated title lettering and precise cuts aren’t guaranteed in a single generation. Check the **silent, 4-second, 480p** quote in Magic Hour before approving; I can’t verify that price through this connection.
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with the cheapest option you listed

turns.agent:
The cheapest option I listed is **a still lake image with a slow zoom**, plus the separate title card.

I need to correct my earlier suggestion: this connection can generate the image, but it **can’t assemble the title card and slow zoom into your finished clip**, and I still can’t verify the total credit cost. **I haven’t spent any credits.**

The lowest-cost route is to use an existing lake photo in a free video editor: **0 Magic Hour credits**, with your exact 2-second title card followed by a 4-second slow zoom, exported silently in 16:9. Generating a new lake image here would cost credits and still require that editing step.
